answer_1.quote: Our work addresses task variability in citation text generation -a widely studied scholarly NLG task aiming to increase efficiency of scientific work.
answer_1.outputs: paragraph-level citation texts for related work sections

answer_2.quote: Our measurements encompass conventional, surface-level, and NLI-based metrics and enable comprehensive analysis of the generated texts and the relationships between the metrics.

answer_4.quote: For the same set of instances, the respective Llama 2-Chat and GPT 3.5 outputs were manually evaluated by the annotators in terms of their correspondence to the gold reference.
answer_4.guideline: The pyramid method, in which the generated output is compared to the gold reference in terms of its compliance with a set of basic facts derived from the reference.
